fact: Tech Africa News reports that the 2026 MoMo Fintech Lab, launched 12 August 2026 by Mobile Money Fintech Limited with Hubtel as technology partner, is a three-month programme giving fintech innovators hackathons, mentorship and incubation support before a national Demo Day.
A Graphic Online opinion column says the 2026 budget gives GH¢70 million to Digital Youth Hubs.

Business Tech Africa reports the Kosmos Innovation Center, with the Mastercard Foundation, named ten winners of the 2026 AgriTech Challenge Pro on 29 October 2026, who now enter KIC's Incubation Programme.

UNICEF Ghana says the UNICEF Start-up Lab, established in 2019 and implemented by MEST Africa with KOICA support, welcomed its sixth cohort of 20 startups on 13 April 2026 into a six-month, six-module accelerator programme, having supported over 100 startups.
Ghana Digital Centres Limited's business development manager told a parliamentary committee that more than 500 startups have received incubation and support at the Accra Digital Centre.
The same official said the Accra Digital Centre hosts more than 60 technology companies at over 60% occupancy.
